name: security-join-gate
description: On-join security filters: no avatar, min age, unverified bots, advertising names, suspicious accounts, username patterns, and raid detection

configFields.label: Min Account Age (hours)
configFields.description: Accounts younger than this are gated. 0 disables.

configFields.label: Raid Join Count
configFields.description: Joins within raid window that activate raid mode

configFields.label: Raid Window (seconds)
configFields.description: Window for counting joins toward raid detection

configFields.label: Raid Action
configFields.description: Action applied to gated joiners during a raid

configFields.label: Raid Response Scope
configFields.description: Apply raid action to all joiners or only suspicious ones

configFields.label: Raid Warn Roles
configFields.description: Role IDs mentioned in log when raid mode activates

configFields.label: Filter: No Avatar
configFields.description: Flag members who have never set a custom avatar

configFields.label: Filter: Min Account Age
configFields.description: Flag accounts younger than configured age

configFields.label: Min Account Age (hours)
configFields.description: Accounts younger than this trip the filter

configFields.label: Filter: Unverified Bots
configFields.description: Flag bot accounts that aren't Discord-verified

configFields.label: Filter: Username Pattern
configFields.description: Flag members whose username contains configured substring

configFields.label: Username Patterns
configFields.description: Substrings matched against usernames (one per line)

configFields.label: Filter: Advertising Account
configFields.description: Flag members whose display name is a link/invite
